repos_data.description: The context every AI coding agent reads — authors AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md & .cursorrules from your repo's real stack. IANA-registered .faf format.

Turn any folder or Git repo into safe, token-efficient context for LLMs, AI chats, and coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor — local-first GUI, TUI, CLI, and a read-only MCP server with Live Context, agent journal, Smart Ignore, secret/PII redaction, Git scopes, and code compression. Windows, macOS, Linux.
Persistent Project Context for Claude — IANA-registered .faf format · Core 14 MCP tools (30 with FAF_TOOLS=all) + 2 prompts · MCP Registry #2759
